name: AKSHAT PATHAK
address: Viterbi Student and Academic Services Hiring Committee
salutation: Dear Viterbi Student and Academic Services Hiring Committee,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Student Services Assistant role because I know how much a small administrative detail can change a student's semester. I am a USC Marshall MBA candidate and an international student, and I would value the chance to help Viterbi students get clear, careful support when they are navigating advisement, forms, deadlines, and unfamiliar university processes.

That student journey is also the focus of my current work with Fluo. Working directly with the founder, I mapped 35 interdependent arrival steps for international students and built an interactive plan that reshapes itself when a visa, housing, banking, or campus task slips. I also used USC program calendars to correct the initial outreach plan and focus on Viterbi's live pre-departure window. The work has made me unusually attentive to dependencies, deadlines, and the difference between giving a student information and helping them understand what to do next.

At Marshall, I support alumni and external-relations work for the South Asian Business Association and High Tech Association. Before USC, I spent five years in engineering roles where accurate records, clear written handoffs, and calm coordination across teams mattered every day. At Intuit, for example, I coordinated Engineering, QA, and Support during a billing issue affecting more than 1,500 businesses. I understand that VSAS handles FERPA-protected and other sensitive information, and I would bring the same discretion and process discipline to that responsibility.

I can work the role's 10–20 hour in-person schedule and would be glad to support student issues, advisement, special projects, and administrative processing wherever the office needs reliable help. Thank you for considering my application.
